name: search_logo
description: Search brand and UI SVG logos by name (e.g. 'discord', 'nextjs', 'figma') from the open svgl.app library. FREE, no retrieval limit. Returns each match's title, category, and the SVG file url(s) - `svgUrl` (light) and, for themed logos, `darkSvgUrl`. Fetch a url to get the raw SVG markup to drop into a project. Use this when the user needs a brand/company logo or a common UI icon-mark.
